eligibility_evidence: About Us At National Grid, we keep people connected and society moving.
National Grid supplies us with the environment to make it happen.
We want to find an innovative, adaptable, and results-oriented Senior Network Engineer for our IT Critical National Infrastructure Generation team .
What You'll Do As Senior Network Engineer, you'll support the overall operation of National Grid's mission critical infrastructure for Generation Operations.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Provide technical expertise and strategic guidance on network architecture, upgrades, lifecycle management, and emerging technologies to meet evolving business needs. Expertise in LAN technologies, including VLANs, STP, EtherChannel, stacking, redundancy, and QoS. National Grid utilizes an assessment that evaluates the job qualifications/characteristics using AI or statistically based scoring. This position has a career path which provides for advancement opportunities within and across bands as you develop and evolve in the position; gaining experience, expertise and acquiring and applying technical skills. Candidates will be assessed and provided offers against the minimum qualifications of this role and their individual experience.
